description: 更贵但偏好更匹配时保留备选，不重复相同购物篮。
回本向上取整，零/负节省不生成有限次数。
普通早餐组合必须进入详情核验，附带会员条件的组合仍被排除。
无解时保留要求，不为了生成推荐自动换掉约束。
预算等于实际全单价属于可行。
改B口味不会丢掉A的要求或修改预算。
换店后不使用旧店价格或优惠。
首版单券边界阻止一张券重复给两个人用。
低价但辣度未知的餐不会混入符合要求的方案。
非辣的“辣”字不能反向判为辣味。
避免Python将False与0视作相同而误判。
超范围人群、模式和布尔预算不会悄悄运行。
实时模式即使给了菜单价也必须等官方报价。

description: 损坏套餐、餐品或事实容器应产生受控错误，不能抛AttributeError。
缺失本地费用时不声称算出完整实付。
牛鸡混合名称不被标成单一牛肉属性。
金额单位显式处理，不口算/猜单位或舍入。
低餐费加高卡费不能挤掉无卡更便宜的同内容方案。
真实到店回包可缺费用拆分，采用官方总额但不伪填零。
保存会话只给当前用户读写，不因默认umask开放。
费用冲突、商品错配或总价缺失不会作为可确认方案。
字段顺序不改变身份，预算或用餐时间改变会更新身份。
修改不误创建陌生用餐者或忽略拼错字段。
低糖/原味不自动等于无糖/不辣。
其他门店的报价即使商品相同也不能采纳。
业务失败不能因为HTTP成功被接受，消息内容不泄漏。
无糖替换使用返回的选项编码，不靠备注。
所有交易工具在任何网络调用前被拒绝。
通知不被误读为工具成功。
Each advertised subcommand has discoverable parser help.
Both modes reproduce 38→43 without a network client.
A saved plan can be amended in both presentation modes; a failed plan exits 2.
Missing/bad/top-level-array/non-UTF8 files return controlled JSON with no trace.
Missing menu or malformed saved state cannot silently reuse or invent prices.
Tool discovery exposes only whitelist names; store output drops private fields.
The actual live CLI path saves state and a later patch performs fresh quotes.
Client initialization failures return a safe error instead of printing secrets.
Rendering explains provenance, hard checks, pricing time and missing breakdowns.
Atomic replace failure leaves the previous file untouched and removes partial output.
A pre-existing .tmp symlink cannot overwrite another user's chosen file.
Both new and overwritten states are private; serialization failure keeps old state.
The distributable entry script runs as __main__ and stays inert when imported.
Invalid units/precision/nonfinite values fail; large cents remain exact.
Missing, unknown and wrongly typed context fields are rejected.

description: Malformed metadata, missing meal roles and price/quantity errors fail safely.
Absent/null evidence is unknown; false and conflicting values stay distinct.
Local prices cannot become live quotes; invalid/missing evidence is not ready.
Missing price, missing fees and bool fees cannot produce a final amount.
At most 30 candidates per person and 900 pairs, with zero input mutation.
No false delta on failure; unchanged chosen meal reports a zero price delta.
Zero fee is immediate break even; invalid fees/savings must not be coerced.
Identity is stable by field order but changes with transaction-affecting input.
For 120 small menus, every feasible outcome matches an independent enumerator.
Single-field JSON type mutations return a valid result or controlled InputError.
Malformed saved plan containers and monetary types must not escape as a traceback.
A must receive chicken and B beef even when the reversed basket costs the same.

description: Incomplete rounds, multi-select defaults, zero mains and bad codes are skipped.
Repeated default variants deduplicate; valid coupon codes stay only in wire input.
Total, nonnegative integer units, fee sums, quantities and SKUs must agree.
Unsupported time/store/schema and malformed service containers stop safely.
Skip members/groups/sides; sort malformed hints safely; fetch at most six regulars.
At most two coupon products; skipped failed details are counted.
Exercise the entire real planner against deterministic official-schema fixtures.
Person ordering duplicates share one request opportunity, capped at three.
Broken upstream default/choice/modification containers never produce a fabricated meal.
Malformed remote schemas/coupon lists stop before using guessed wire parameters.
Three over-budget quotes do not resolve remaining unquoted candidates.
A coupon offered by lookup is still unusable if official pricing rejects it.
Missing, ambiguous and whitespace credentials fail without revealing content.
JSON and SSE select the right ID; malformed payloads fail with safe errors.
Tool failures never expose account messages; both structured/text formats work.
Invalid envelopes, oversized responses and mismatched IDs are not accepted.
Initialize/notification propagate the negotiated protocol and opaque session.
Authentication, redirect and bad request stop; transient errors retry at most twice.
All pages are combined once; repeated cursors and overlong sequences stop.
Every allowed tool uses readonly transport; every mutation remains unreachable.
